alignments.note: The ASV's underlying text opens this verse with Ὁ δὲ μισθωτὸς φεύγει, a reading the selected base text omits (textual unit SBLGNT.JHN.10.13.v012), and the ASV italicizes 'he fleeth' accordingly; no source token in this verse answers to it (rules 5, 12). This is not rule 37: JHN.10.12's φεύγει is aligned to that verse's own 'fleeth'.
Inflected verb takes its English subject and copula.
The indefinite article is a helper licensed by the noun.
The ASV recasts impersonal μέλει αὐτῷ as personal careth, with the subject carried over from the preceding clause; no English word answers to the dative pronoun.
The English preposition governing the phrase realizes περί, not the verb.

review_notes: The opening 'he fleeth' is italicized in the ASV and answers to the clause Ὁ δὲ μισθωτὸς φεύγει, which the chapter's textual decision left out of the projection; it is 'added' under rule 5, not a rule 37 versification shift.
